inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: The policy does not address notifying the NRA of changes to registration data, including a change of the place where inside information is published.
No requirement to notify registration changes to the NRA promptly.
No internal trigger events for registration updates are listed.
No internal time limit for notifying registration changes.
No role is named as responsible for submitting registration changes.
No review frequency for registration data is specified.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: The EEX Transparency Platform forwards our published Urgent Market Messages to ACER.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Explains how published UMMs reach ACER, but says nothing on fundamental capacity/unavailability data, and publication on the IIP is only 'where possible', so ACER may not receive all disclosures.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Inside information is information of a precise nature which has not been made public, which relates directly or indirectly to one or more wholesale energy products
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Definition reproduces all REMIT criteria: precise, non-public, relating to wholesale energy products, likely to significantly affect prices.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: must not recommend or induce another person to do so.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Trading and recommending are prohibited and sharing is limited to need-to-know colleagues, covering disclosure outside the normal course of duties.
The prohibition covers acquiring or disposing only; cancelling or amending orders placed before receipt of inside information is not addressed.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Inside information may only be shared with colleagues who need it to perform their duties (need-to-know).
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Sharing is restricted to need-to-know colleagues in the performance of their duties.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Kraftwerk Elbufer is owned by our sister company Nordwind Erzeugung GmbH and is therefore outside the scope of this policy.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Excludes a group company's plant from the whole policy, including the trading prohibition; REMIT prohibits trading on inside information about any facility, including other companies' facilities.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: any planned or unplanned change of 100 MW or more in the available capacity of a power plant is presumed to be inside information.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Gives a concrete example relevant to the company's power-plant assets.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Employees who believe they have received inside information must inform Compliance immediately.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Staff must escalate possible inside information to Compliance immediately.
The policy does not state which insider-trading exemptions, if any, the company relies on.
No requirement to evidence that agreements or orders behind exempt transactions predate receipt of inside information.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Inside information is published on our company website www.nordwind-trading.example and, where possible, also on the EEX Transparency Platform.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Names EEX Transparency Platform but makes IIP publication optional ('where possible') with the website as primary channel; REMIT II requires disclosure through an IIP.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Only information about facilities owned by Nordwind Trading itself needs to be published under this policy.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Article 4(1) covers facilities owned, controlled or operated by the parent or related undertakings; the policy excludes the sister company's Kraftwerk Elbufer and does not assign disclosure responsibility.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Inside information is published on our company website www.nordwind-trading.example and, where possible, also on the EEX Transparency Platform.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: The website is the primary channel and the IIP secondary; ACER expects the website to be additional only, with identical content. No identical-content requirement.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Compliance assesses whether information is inside information using the criteria in paragraph 2.1.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Compliance is named as the function assessing inside information.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Each message is checked by a second person from the Market Operations team before publication.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Implies Market Operations prepares and publishes UMMs, but does not expressly name who publishes on the IIP.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Publication takes place within 24 hours of the information becoming known to Nordwind Trading.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: A 24-hour window is inconsistent with disclosure in a timely manner / without delay under Article 4(1).

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Employees who possess inside information must not acquire or dispose of wholesale energy products to which the information relates
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: General prohibition on trading while holding inside information implies no trading before publication, but there is no explicit rule tying trading to UMM publication.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Publication takes place within 24 hours of the information becoming known to Nordwind Trading.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Sets a 24-hour deadline, far beyond ACER's expectation of publication at the latest within one hour.
No on-call or 24/7 publication arrangement outside office hours.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: publication date/time
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: The UMM template contains a publication date/time field, but the policy does not require the publication time to be recorded internally.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Urgent Market Messages are prepared using the template in Annex A, which follows the data fields of Annex VII of the ACER Manual of Procedures on data reporting.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Refers to Annex VII fields and provides a template.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: When the expected duration or the available capacity changes, the message is updated as soon as the new information is available.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: UMM updates on changes in duration or capacity are required.
Nothing excludes executive statements, advertising or disclaimers from UMMs.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Each message is checked by a second person from the Market Operations team before publication.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: A four-eyes check by Market Operations is required, but it is not stated that the check is against the required Annex VII fields.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: The Head of Trading may decide to delay publication of inside information
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Names the Head of Trading as decision-maker on delay (note: trading-side decision-maker raises conflict concerns).

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: The Head of Trading may decide to delay publication of inside information if publication would harm Nordwind Trading's commercial interests.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Only a broad commercial-interest ground; the not-misleading and confidentiality conditions of Article 4(2) are absent.
No prohibition on trading decisions based on information whose disclosure is delayed.
No notification of ACER and the NRA with justification; only internal documentation is required.
No requirement to disclose once the legitimate interest ends.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Compliance documents each decision to delay publication, including the reasons.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Delay decisions and reasons are documented by Compliance.
No reference to ACER's standard delay-notification format.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Inside information may be shared with external advisers and banks only after they have signed a non-disclosure agreement.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: External sharing is limited to recipients bound by contractual confidentiality, satisfying the Article 4(3) exception.
No requirement to publish as soon as possible after an unintentional disclosure.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Inside information may be shared with external advisers and banks only after they have signed a non-disclosure agreement.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: NDAs are required for external recipients.
No backup publication channel or IIP-failure procedure is described.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Employees who possess inside information must not acquire or dispose of wholesale energy products to which the information relates
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: General insider-trading prohibition applies, but the policy does not state that it continues until publication, e.g. during an IIP outage.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Where an outage is also published on the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, this satisfies our obligation under REMIT and no separate Urgent Market Message is needed.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Relies on ENTSO-E publication alone; under Article 4(4) such publication is effective but not necessarily timely and public disclosure under Article 4(1).
Delay for classified critical-infrastructure information is not addressed.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: any planned or unplanned change of 100 MW or more in the available capacity of a power plant is presumed to be inside information.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: A 100 MW threshold and the paragraph 2.1 criteria are set for assessment.
No map of where inside information arises (assets, departments) or how it flows.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Compliance keeps a list of all persons who have access to inside information about the plants marketed by Nordwind Trading.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: An insider list is maintained by Compliance.
No log of who received inside information and when, including during delayed disclosure.

inside-information-policy.docx.evidence: Plant operations staff sit in a separate building and have no access to trading systems.
inside-information-policy.docx.explanation: Describes physical and system separation between plant operations and trading.
No trade-stop mechanism or record of its use is described.
Erroneous orders or trades are not addressed.
No investigation steps after erroneous orders.

market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: The policy contains no definition of inside information.
No prohibition on trading, recommending or disclosing while holding inside information.
Cancelling or amending orders on the basis of inside information is not addressed.
No need-to-know rule for sharing inside information.
No statement on trading on inside information about other companies' facilities.
No example of inside information is given.
No escalation requirement for possible inside information; P11 covers only market-abuse concerns generally.
No insider-trading exemptions are stated.
No evidence requirement for exempt transactions.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Market manipulation is strictly prohibited.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Market manipulation is prohibited, but attempted market manipulation is not mentioned.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: the following practices are prohibited: wash trades, layering and spoofing, marking the close, and placing orders without the intention to execute them.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Specific prohibited practices are named.
Physical and economic capacity withholding are not addressed.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Trades between Nordwind group companies on EPEX SPOT are allowed to balance positions within the group.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Permits intra-group trades on the exchange without controls or monitoring; such trades without change in beneficial interest risk being wash trades, a practice ACER treats as manipulation.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Any employee who has concerns about possible market abuse must report them to Compliance.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Staff must report market-abuse concerns to Compliance.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Only the Communications department may speak to the press or publish statements about market conditions. Traders must not comment on market rumours on social media.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Restricts who communicates externally, but does not prohibit disseminating false or misleading information on supply, demand or prices, nor cover analyst calls.
Data submitted to price reporting agencies or benchmark administrators is not addressed.
No rule on who submits data to price reporters or how accuracy is checked.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Every algorithm runs within pre-trade limits: a price collar of ±20% around the last traded price, a maximum order volume of 50 MW
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Thresholds and limits for algorithms are defined.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Orders that breach a pre-trade limit are rejected automatically.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Automatic rejection of orders breaching pre-trade limits prevents erroneous orders.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: New algorithms are tested in the EPEX simulation environment before go-live
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Testing before deployment is required, but not testing after changes to existing algorithms.
No business continuity arrangements for algorithmic system failure.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: The intraday desk monitors running algorithms during trading hours.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: The intraday desk is named as monitoring function.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: a price collar of ±20% around the last traded price, a maximum order volume of 50 MW, and a maximum of 30 order messages per second.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Price, volume and order-rate limits are specified.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: The intraday desk can stop all algorithms immediately with a kill switch.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: A kill switch exists.
No notification of algorithmic trading to the NRA and ACER.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Documentation of algorithms, including strategy descriptions, parameters and test results, is kept for three years.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Strategy descriptions, parameters and test results are kept, but limits and controls are not listed and nothing addresses providing them on request.
No role is named to maintain the algorithmic-trading notification.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Documentation of algorithms, including strategy descriptions, parameters and test results, is kept for three years.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Three-year retention is shorter than the five years required by Article 5a(2) REMIT.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Documentation of algorithms, including strategy descriptions, parameters and test results
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Strategies, parameters and tests are listed; limits and changes are not.
Traded products are not mapped to REMIT-only or REMIT-and-MAR.
No statement that MAR applies to products that are financial instruments.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Owner: Head of Trading, with Compliance
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Compliance is mentioned as reporting recipient and co-owner, but no REMIT compliance officer or responsible function is defined.
No statement that Compliance reports to senior management independently of trading; the policy is owned and reviewed by the Head of Trading.
No statement on Compliance access to trading and operational information.
Training is not addressed.
No training frequency or onboarding training.
No training attendance records.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Reports can also be made anonymously through the group whistleblowing system
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Concerns can be raised to Compliance or anonymously.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: nobody will suffer disadvantages for reporting in good faith.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Protection from retaliation for good-faith reporting.
No information barriers between asset operations and trading are described.
No trade-stop mechanism for inside information; the algorithm kill switch is not a documented trade stop.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Trader telephone lines and Bloomberg chats are recorded.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Recorded channels named: phone and Bloomberg chat (e-mail not mentioned).

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Recordings, chat logs and trade tickets are kept for five years.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Five-year retention for communications and trade records.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: Each trader trades only within the products, markets and limits set out in his or her individual trading mandate
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Documented individual trading mandates and limits.
No requirement to record reasons for unusual orders or trades.
Erroneous orders are not assessed as possible inside information.
No incident investigation steps after erroneous orders.

market-conduct-policy.docx.evidence: New algorithms are tested in the EPEX simulation environment before go-live and require the written approval of the Head of Trading.
market-conduct-policy.docx.explanation: Written approval before go-live for new algorithms, but changes to existing algorithms are not covered.
Vendor-supplied algorithms are not addressed.
No compliance sign-off before new products or venues; mandates are approved by Trading and Risk Management only.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Nordwind Trading is registered as a market participant with the Bundesnetzagentur (ACER code A0001234N.DE).
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Names Bundesnetzagentur as the NRA.
No requirement that new group entities register before starting reportable trading.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: The Head of Back Office is responsible for the registration in CEREMP and for keeping it up to date.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Responsible role named.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: The ACER code is recorded in the static data of the trading system.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: States where the ACER code is recorded.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Changes to registration data are reported to the Bundesnetzagentur at the annual review of registration data in January.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Changes are reported to the NRA, but only annually rather than as they occur; specific items like place of publication of inside information are not mentioned.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Changes to registration data are reported to the Bundesnetzagentur at the annual review of registration data in January.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Batching changes to an annual January review can delay notification up to a year; Article 9(5) requires prompt notification.
No internal trigger events for registration updates are listed.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Changes to registration data are reported to the Bundesnetzagentur at the annual review of registration data in January.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Instead of a short internal time limit, changes wait for the annual review, inconsistent with prompt notification.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: The Head of Back Office is responsible for the registration in CEREMP and for keeping it up to date.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Head of Back Office responsible for registration updates.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: at the annual review of registration data in January.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Annual review of registration data is specified.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: power and natural gas spot and futures on EEX and EPEX SPOT, and OTC forwards in power and gas through brokers and bilaterally, including non-standard contracts
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Lists reportable products and venues.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: reported by Nordwind Trading through the registered reporting mechanism TradeLink RRM.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Names TradeLink RRM and exchanges reporting on the company's behalf.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Only executed transactions are reported. Orders that are not executed are not reportable.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: REMIT requires reporting of orders to trade as well as transactions; excluding non-executed orders conflicts with Article 8(1).

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: OTC trades, including non-standard contracts, are reported by Nordwind Trading through the registered reporting mechanism TradeLink RRM.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Off-OMP trades, including non-standard contracts, are reported by the company via its RRM.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Standard contracts are reported by the end of the next working day (T+1).
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: T+1 is stricter than the two-working-day deadline.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Non-standard contracts are reported within one month of their conclusion.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: One month exceeds the ten-working-day deadline for non-standard contracts.
Deadlines are not applied to lifecycle events (amendments, cancellations, terminations).

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Standard contracts are reported by the end of the next working day (T+1).
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Distinguishes standard and non-standard contracts, but does not classify OMP vs OTC trades or address off-venue lifecycle events on OMP trades.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Trades on EEX and EPEX SPOT are also reported to ACER by the exchanges.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Identifies that exchanges report OMP trades and the company reports OTC trades via TradeLink RRM.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Back Office checks every morning that the exchanges' reporting confirmations have been received.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Daily verification that exchange reports were submitted.
Only receipt of exchange confirmations is checked; accuracy of delegated reports is not verified.
No escalation, including informing NRA and ACER, when the RRM or third party cannot report.
No statement on how fundamental data and disclosed inside information reach ACER.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: To be on the safe side, Nordwind Trading additionally reports all trades executed on EEX and EPEX SPOT through TradeLink RRM.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Market participants must not report OMP data themselves; the company duplicates exchange reporting.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Back Office checks every morning that the exchanges' reporting confirmations have been received.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Exchange confirmations are checked for receipt, but OMP reported-data access is not used to reconcile records.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Back Office reconciles the trades reported through TradeLink RRM against the trade blotter of the trading system to ensure that all trades have been reported.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Completeness reconciliation against the trading system.
No check that reported fields are accurate; reconciliation targets completeness only.
No check that reports were submitted within the applicable deadline.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Rejected reports and validation errors received from TradeLink RRM are corrected and resubmitted on the same working day.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Rejections and validation errors are corrected and resubmitted same day.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Every working day, Back Office reconciles the trades reported through TradeLink RRM
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Daily reconciliation frequency.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Intragroup trades between Nordwind companies concluded outside an organised market place are not REMIT-relevant and are not recorded for REMIT purposes.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Off-OMP intragroup trades are reportable on ACER request and their details must be kept; the procedure declares them irrelevant and keeps no records.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: are not REMIT-relevant and are not recorded for REMIT purposes.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: No records are kept, conflicting with the five-year retention requirement following conclusion.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Intragroup trades between Nordwind companies concluded outside an organised market place are not REMIT-relevant
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Identifies off-OMP intragroup trades but wrongly classifies them as not REMIT-relevant rather than reportable on request.
No process for answering ad-hoc ACER requests for these transactions.

transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.evidence: Original OTC and non-standard contracts are archived in the contract management system and can be retrieved on request.
transaction-reporting-procedure.docx.explanation: Original contracts are archived and retrievable.
No one is named to answer ACER data-quality queries.
Algorithmic trading notification is not addressed.
No algorithm documentation is kept ready for requests.
No role named for the algorithmic-trading notification.
